v38_stale_setup.description: CYCLE-005 intake D1, part one. Claims a pig as handle a in session v38s, then stops the session, which empties the cache and leaves the tag on the pig. Run v38_stale_adopt or v38_stale_refuse next.

v38_stale_adopt.description: Run v38_stale_setup first. Part two. A new session of the same name claims the pig again under a: FIXTURE action=claim adopted=true; list shows it loaded; clear a removes it. In 1.3.0 the claim was refused as already claimed and the clear found no handle.

v38_stale_refuse.description: Run v38_stale_setup first. Part two, other handle. The new session tries handle b for the same pig: refused, naming a (expect failed=1). Then clear all finds the pig by its tag and removes it.

v38_scope.description: Session a must not own session a.b's fixtures. Claims a pig in session a.b, switches to session a, claims a second pig there, and runs clear all: only session a's pig is removed. Then back to a.b, whose clear all removes the first pig.

v38_release.description: fixture release removes the tag and keeps the entity: FIXTURE action=release outcome=released, then the NBT shows no devtool.fx tag. The bundle kills the pig at the end.

v38_dotted_handle.description: A handle with a dot is refused (expect failed=1); the pig is killed afterwards.
